newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen 91-day treasury bills average 21.02 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yemen 91-day treasury bills average 21.02 pct.

text.p: The central bank of Yemen said on Monday its latest issue of 91-day treasury bills yielded an average of 21.02 percent, up on an average 20.71 percent in its January 8 auction.
Of the 2.5 billion rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 2.39 billion rials.
The average price was 9,502.08 rials and the lowest price accepted was 9,425 rials. Yields ranged from 19.08 percent to 24.47 percent.
The latest issue of 182-day bills yielded an average 21.87 percent, up from last month's average of 21.22 percent.
Of the one billion rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 855 million rials.
The average price was 9,016.62 rials and the lowest price accepted was 8,880 rials. Yields ranged from 19.83 percent to 25.29 percent.
The issue of 364-day bills, the second issued by the bank, yielded an average 22.30 percent, up from last month's average of 21.95 percent.
Of the 500 million rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 386 million rials.
The average price was 8,181.02 rials, with the lowest price accepted at 8065 rials.
Yields ranged from 21.68 percent to 24.06 percent.
The bank did not say when the next issue will be held in March.
